items.title: AMD, Amgen, Novartis, Qualcomn, Corning, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks declined on Tuesday as oil prices rose, renewing investor worries about hotter inflation and bolstering the case for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates. Investor attention may turn to Apple on Wednesday when the company holds its iPhone launch event.

items.title: Verizon’s Megadeal Proves Corning Is Integral to the AI Grid
items.summary: Corning and Verizon agree on a supply agreement that runs through 2032 for broadband and AI infrastructure.

items.title: Optical Stocks Surge as Corning Inks Multibillion-Dollar Deal With Verizon
items.summary: Corning shares are soaring after the company agreed to a lucrative supply agreement with Verizon.

items.title: AI-Related Stocks Are Soaring After OpenAI’s Astra Model Release
items.summary: Stocks tied to AI are having a big day amid growing enthusiasm over OpenAI's latest model, called Astra. Shares of CoreWeave, an AI cloud infrastructure company, rose 12% Tuesday. Shares of Lumentum and Coherent, which manufacture optical and laser equipment used by AI data centers, were up 11% and 7% respectively.

items.title: AAOI Dips 46% in Three Months: Should You Buy the Stock Now or Wait?
items.summary: Applied Optoelectronics plunges 46.3% in three months as supply constraints and a rich valuation offset surging AI-driven demand for 800G and 1.6T products.

items.title: Which Optics Stock Has Dominated in 2026: Applied Optoelectronics, Lumentum, or Coherent?
items.summary: AI datacenter spending has turned optical networking into one of 2026's hottest trades, but the three biggest U.S. optics stocks have performed so differently that picking the wrong one meant leaving triple-digit gains on the table.

items.title: GoPro Zooms 34% Higher on Starman Optical Merger and Markiplier Stake; Coherent Climbs 7%, Lumentum Gains 3%
items.summary: GoPro is surging on a merger that turns a camera company into an optical-transceiver play, and a famous YouTuber just became its largest individual shareholder. Here is what the move actually means against a backdrop of proven incumbents already delivering billion-dollar datacenter revenue.

items.title: Coherent (COHR) Stock Looks Below Fair Value While Earnings Look Fair
items.summary: Coherent stock has delivered a very large 3 year gain, yet the latest Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate points to the shares trading at roughly half of that model’s value, while broader valuation checks look more mixed than clearly cheap. Over the past 3 years Coherent shares are up roughly 7x, which puts recent price swings into a very different context for anyone thinking about new money going into the stock.
